svg.title: Cross-view optimization diagram reconstructed as editable SVG
svg.desc: Full figure contains four dotted base frames: initial point cloud at upper left, ground-truth Gaussian splat at lower left, an upper-right comparison panel without CVO, and a lower-right comparison panel with CVO. Middle-left unframed initialization arrows connect the point cloud to a single green Gaussian splat and then to the right panels. Each right panel contains camera frustums, Gaussian splats, curved relation arrows, explanatory labels, and a caption.

rect.desc: Upper-left base frame: initial point cloud with faint car/landscape point distribution and a red selected point at lower left.
Lower-left base frame: Ground Truth Gaussian Splat with three camera frustums and three green Gaussian splats arranged diagonally.
Upper-right base frame: Original 3D-GS without CVO. Left half shows independent views at iteration i, right half shows ambiguous possible results at iteration i+1.
Lower-right base frame: Cross-view joint optimization with CVO. Left half shows correlated views at iteration i and right half converges to rotate-plus-scale ground truth at iteration i+1.

g.desc: Origin for this frame is the red selected point near the lower-left of the cloud. The cloud spreads upward and rightward into foliage, sky/building haze, road, and car-like point clusters.
Flow descends from the selected red point to the after-initialization Gaussian, then rightward to split toward the two comparison panels.
Ground truth frame uses a loose triangular symmetry: blue upper camera, orange lower-left camera, red right camera, and green splats centered in or between the camera views.

Upper panel origin is the View 1 camera and splat at lower left. From it the drawing conducts upward to faint View 3, rightward to a green splat and faint View 2, then further right to ambiguous rotate, scale, and rotate-plus-scale outcomes. The section is horizontally partitioned into iteration i on the left and iteration i+1 on the right.
g.text: a) Original 3D-GS: Insufficient constraints and random-view-select training strategy brings ambiguous optimization results.

g.desc: Lower panel origin is the View 1 camera and splat at lower left. The correlated relation conducts rightward to View 2 and upward/rightward to a constrained final state. The section is divided into iteration i with CVO and iteration i+1 with CVO; final motion is rotate plus scale toward ground truth.
g.text: b) Cross-View Joint Optimization (Ours): More constrained and accurate gaussian splat within two iterations.
